_readme: What the clothing designer (npcgen/clothing.py) offers on top of the Body Designer's garments (bodydesigner/garments.py, which owns the kinds, their defaults and the ranges of looseness and length: they are read from its catalogue, never copied here). The Body Designer also says what it does not offer and why (`control_notes`, shown under the slider), and what it still reads of a design saved earlier. `fields` are the labels, units, steps and hints the editor shows; `choices` the cloth lists; `colours` the swatches (the colours of data/outfit.json, so a sheet's outfit and a designed garment use the same ones); `words` are what 'Set the controls from my words' understands: `ease` words set the looseness in millimetres, `length` words the length as a multiple of the usual one, `cloth` words the cloth. A word that is not here changes nothing. Read fresh on every request.

ease_mm.label: Looseness
ease_mm.hint: How far the cloth stands off the body. 0 is skin tight; a shirt is usually 8 to 16 mm, trousers 2 to 6 mm; a jacket, an apron, a skirt and a dress start at 0.

length.label: Length
length.hint: The hem, as a multiple of the usual length: below 1 is shorter, above 1 longer. The ends of the slider are the lengths the Body Designer fits.

texture.weave: Woven (a faint weave in the cloth)
